Build the material with us

From evaluation to application fit

NeoNaar works with formulators, research groups, manufacturers and technology companies to evaluate cellulose and lignocellulosic materials inside real systems.

Current development areas

  • Residual-lignin MFC for barrier coatings
  • Seed-coating matrices and agricultural suspensions
  • Biomethane-performance materials
  • Cellulose redispersion and dry formats
  • Biopolymer reinforcement
  • Application-specific cellulose grades

Engagement model

Evaluation sample → controlled testing → material optimisation → pilot supply → commercial grade

Each step depends on the evidence, application requirements and development readiness. Current research does not imply that all platforms are commercially validated or that dry formats are available.
